description: Work backward from a California civil trial date to the pretrial deadlines: the discovery cutoff and the motion cutoff, the expert exchange and expert discovery cutoffs, the last day to serve written discovery so responses are due before the cutoff, and the summary judgment dates. Optionally adds the local-rule deadlines for one of the counties this site tracks.

county.description: Optional. Adds that county's local-rule deadlines where they are computable from the trial date.

service_method.description: How summary judgment papers would be served, for the section 437c rows.

set_date.description: Optional. The date the trial date was set, which some local rules count from.

name: california_trial_countdown
title: California pretrial deadlines from a trial date
